records.title: Skill-Guided Continuation Distillation for GUI Agents
records.reason: SGCD improves GUI-agent behavior via continuation distillation and expert trajectories; the described contribution is training supervision and success quality, without an inference-efficiency result.

records.title: Active Imitation Learning for Thermal- and Kernel-Aware LFM Inference on 3D S-NUCA Many-Cores
records.reason: AILFM schedules large-foundation-model inference on heterogeneous 3D S-NUCA CPUs using kernel-aware thread migration and V/f scaling to balance thermal safety and performance, directly addressing inference runtime and resource efficiency.

records.title: Conflict-Free Policy Languages for Probabilistic ML Predicates: A Framework and Case Study with the Semantic Router DSL
records.reason: The work implements conflict detection and prevention in a production semantic-router DSL for LLM inference, preventing probabilistic routing predicates from co-firing and misrouting requests; this is directly in the serving/runtime path.

records.title: Zero-Shot Robotic Manipulation via 3D Gaussian Splatting-Enhanced Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
records.reason: The MLLM is one component of a zero-shot robotic manipulation application using retrieval and 3D pose refinement; the abstract gives task success gains, not inference-system efficiency.

records.title: J-CoT: Chain-of-Thought in J-Space
records.reason: J-CoT uses a compact vocabulary-indexed latent interface for recurrent reasoning, but the abstract reports benchmark quality under matched settings without demonstrating reduced inference compute or latency.

records.title: Learning from Audio-Dependency Errors: Data Curation Strategies Based on Model Confusion Patterns in Audio Question Answering
records.reason: This is audio-QA data curation and fine-tuning for accuracy; its train-only model changes do not establish inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Inducing Reasoning Primitives from Agent Traces
records.reason: The induced pseudo-tool library is invoked by an LLM at test time, and the abstract reports lower average inference cost than AWM while preserving reasoning task gains; this is a concrete inference-cost optimization for agent execution.

records.title: Worth Remembering: Surprise-Gated Robot Episodic Memory
records.reason: Surprise-gated episodic memory improves robot scene-graph question answering and event segmentation; it is a robotics memory application, not LLM inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Energy per Successful Goal: Goal-Level Energy Accounting for Agentic AI Systems
records.reason: A-LEMS measures energy per successful agent goal across retries, tool calls, and local/remote inference; it supplies a reproducible performance/energy measurement framework for agentic inference systems.

records.title: MI-Fuse: Label Fusion for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation with Closed-Source Large Audio-Language Model
records.reason: MI-Fuse trains a student for speech-emotion recognition from an API-only audio-language model and auxiliary teacher; the target is audio domain adaptation/accuracy rather than LLM inference-system efficiency.

records.title: AnchorRefine: Synergy-Manipulation Based on Trajectory Anchor and Residual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
records.reason: The arXiv record says AnchorRefine was withdrawn and describes VLA robot-manipulation success improvements, not inference-system efficiency.

records.title: Automated Bengali Physics MCQ Solver: A Large Language Model Approach with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
records.reason: The DOI resolver/official IEEE publisher abstract could not be retrieved; available search result was third-party-only, so the imported title/abstract was not treated as primary evidence.

records.title: Exploring and Exploiting Security Vulnerabilities in Self-Hosted LLM Services
records.reason: Exploring and Exploiting Security Vulnerabilities in Self-Hosted LLM Servicesの対象は入力要旨上The Web ConferenceでのExploring and Exploiting Security Vulnerabilities in Self-Hosted LLM Servicesで、LLM推論・serving効率への具体的寄与が確認できない。

records.title: A Robust Lithium-Ion Battery Capacity Prediction Framework Using Multi-Point Voltage Temporal Features and an OOF-Trained Adaptive Gating Mechanism
records.reason: The official MDPI abstract identifies the contribution as lithium-ion battery capacity prediction using voltage features and a gated XGBoost/LSTM ensemble. Its results concern battery-management prediction accuracy, with no LLM inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Adaptive Parallel Monte Carlo Tree Search for Efficient Test-time Compute Scaling
records.reason: The method prunes unproductive MCTS trajectories and reallocates compute among concurrent searches; integration in vLLM reports lower p99 end-to-end latency and higher throughput at maintained reasoning accuracy, squarely in inference serving.

records.title: LightMover: Generative Light Movement with Color and Intensity Controls
records.reason: LightMover is a controllable image-lighting diffusion application; token pruning shortens its visual control sequence, but the abstract does not connect this to LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Wafer Defect Recognition for Industrial Inspection: FCS-VMamba Model and Experimental Validation
records.reason: The official MDPI abstract describes VMamba global-context modeling with linear computational complexity and a 1.2M-parameter wafer-defect model. This has a concrete architecture and parameter-efficiency connection to the linked Mamba/state-space inference lineage, so it is retained for Research screening; the paper does not establish measured LLM-serving or edge-device runtime gains.

records.title: Leveraging LLM Parametric Knowledge for Fact Checking without Retrieval
records.reason: The work uses LLM parametric knowledge to improve fact-checking without retrieval; the stated objective is fact-checking quality, not inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: PinPoint: Evaluation of Composed Image Retrieval with Explicit Negatives, Multi-Image Queries, and Paraphrase Testing
records.reason: The work evaluates composed image retrieval quality and robustness and does not report inference-system efficiency.

records.title: RewriteGen: Autonomous Query Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The verified MDPI abstract describes ReWriteGen as a coordinated RAG query-rewriting, retrieval, and generation framework evaluated for QA. The abstract does not establish lower inference latency, higher serving throughput, or reduced serving cost, so its system-efficiency relevance remains unresolved.
